summary: Kootenai County, Idaho Coeur d'Alene NF lookout with an L-4 cab in 1931, known staff in 1946, gone by 1952; a land trust describes remains at the crest.

facts.status_note: Gone by 1952; a land trust describes remains of a Forest Service fire lookout at the crest.

corrections.why: Both history pages say gone in 1952 and do not say abandoned

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three list-style history pages with the same facts, plus one land-trust sentence that is the only evidence of what stands today. The sentence does not say what the remains are. The 1946 staffing comes from a Kellogg Evening News item cited by Idaho Fire Lookouts; not read. Access: no source says whether the summit is open to visitors, so facts.access is omitted. A willhiteweb.com Hudlow Mountain hiking page (idaho_lookouts/hudlow_mountain/hayden_lake_055.htm) turned up in search and may describe the summit today; it was not read because of the budget. The brief's 1952 'abandoned' is proposed as 'gone' in corrections; the sources do not say abandoned. Kind 'ground' in the brief is consistent with the FFLA index ('Ground Gone').
